name: EXM_MISC_POL_LINES
description: This table contains the details of a given miscellaneous policy. Each line in the table contains a miscellaneous policy rate and the applicable rate determinants.

columns.name: POLICY_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of miscellaneous expense policy line.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: MISC_POLICY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of miscellaneous expense policy.

columns.name: TYPE_OF_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Type of rate line, such as base miscellaneous rate or catch all.

columns.name: REIMBURSEMENT_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Percentage if the rate type is percentage reimbursement or percentage reimbursement with rate limit.

columns.name: SINGLE_INSTANCE_LIMIT
columns.description: Indicates whether miscellaneous expense policy limits are enforced by each submitted instance of miscellaneous expense item.

columns.name: DAILY_LIMIT
columns.description: Daily reimbursement limit for miscellaneous expenses.

columns.name: MONTHLY_LIMIT
columns.description: Monthly reimbursement limit for miscellaneous expenses.

columns.name: YEARLY_LIMIT
columns.description: Annual reimbursement limit for miscellaneous expenses.

columns.name: LIFETIME_LIMIT
columns.description: Lifetime reimbursement limit for miscellaneous expenses.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for miscellaneous expense policy.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the rate is applicable.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the rate is no longer applicable.

columns.name: ROLE_ID
columns.description: Role for which this miscellaneous expense policy rate is applicable.

columns.name: ROLE_NAME
columns.description: Role name for which this miscellaneous expense policy rate is applicable, such as Director or Engineer.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Geography for which this miscellaneous expense policy rate is applicable.

columns.name: ZONE_CODE
columns.description: Zone code for which this miscellaneous expense policy rate is applicable, such as Geographical Location or Zone.

columns.name: GEOLOC_NAME
columns.description: Geographical location for which this miscellaneous expense policy rate is applicable.

columns.name: RAW_COUNTRY
columns.description: Country for which this miscellaneous expense policy rate is applicable.

columns.name: RAW_STATE
columns.description: State for which this miscellaneous expense policy rate is applicable.

columns.name: RAW_COUNTY
columns.description: County for which this miscellaneous expense policy rate is applicable.

columns.name: RAW_CITY
columns.description: City for which this miscellaneous expense policy rate is applicable.

columns.name: RAW_LEVEL_5
columns.description: Component of the geographic location for which this miscellaneous expense policy rate is applicable.

columns.name: GENDER_CODE
columns.description: Gender code for miscellaneous expense policy.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of miscellaneous expense policy line, whether Draft, Valid, Invalid, or Active. Values are from lookup EXM_POLICY_STATUS.

columns.name: INVALID_CODE
columns.description: Reason that miscellaneous expense policy line has invalid status.
